evals.prompt: Execute an empirical A/B benchmark evaluation for the python-developer skill using the skill-evaluator protocol.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation benchmark workspace with isolated with_skill and without_skill runs, honest grading.json files, and an aggregated uplift report.
assertions: Schema validation is performed prior to benchmark execution
Subagent executions use isolated workspace directories outside repository root
Grading output includes per-assertion pass/fail determinations with code evidence
Benchmark aggregates pass rates, timing, and token metrics into benchmark.json
Qualitative review notes are recorded in feedback.json

evals.prompt: Scaffold and validate a new evaluation suite for a data pipeline skill.
evals.expected_output: A compliant evals.json file with positive integer IDs, realistic prompts, expected outputs, and falsifiable assertions.
assertions: The generated evals.json passes agentskills.io schema validation
All test case IDs are unique positive integers
Assertions define specific, falsifiable criteria rather than subjective impressions
